title: Global boundedness of the chemotaxis system with weakly singular sensitivity and nonlocal term in any dimension
summary: This paper is concerned with the parabolic-elliptic chemotaxis system involving weakly singular sensitivity and a nonlocal source: $u_t=Δu-χ\nabla\cdot\left(\frac{u}{v^k}\nabla v\right) +u^α\left(r-μ\int_Ωu^β\,dx\right)$ and $0=Δv-v+u^γ$ under homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions in a smooth bounded domain \(Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^N\) with \(N\ge1\), where \(χ,r,μ,γ>0\), \(k\in(0,1)\) and \(α,β\ge1\).
